load_eeg_recording: load a Broderick2019Recording EEG recording for a specific subject and run ID from .mat files
iterate_recordings: iterate over all Broderick2019Recording subjects and runs to yield each recording object
parse_speech_alignment: parse Gentle speech alignment JSON files into a DataFrame with word and phoneme level entries
extract_events: extract speech events with sequence info and sentence blocks from a Broderick2019Recording
download_dataset: download and extract the Broderick 2019 dataset including public EEG files and private audio alignment files
